comparison.objective: Replace a gear-carrying shaft inside a closed housing; candidate commissions a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Housing access, constrained shaft extraction/insertion, gear alignment, and reassembly versus recessed tool use, collar rotation, counterholding, and response-guided locking.
comparison.success_condition: Replacement shaft and gear are correctly installed in the closed housing versus two safe impact cycles with no drift. Record supplies no body or specs.
comparison.reason: Both are maintenance tasks, but component replacement through constrained alignment is materially different from adjustable-damper calibration.
